review.title: Review
review.body: Your due cards from every module gather here — kanji, vocabulary and mined sentences in one queue.
review.unlocks: Study anything with a card, and the queue starts filling itself.

challenges.title: Challenges
challenges.body: Short, timed sets that push one skill harder than a normal session does.
challenges.unlocks: Nothing yet. This screen arrives with the challenge engine.

sensei.title: Sensei
sensei.body: A place to ask about anything you have studied, in your own words.
sensei.unlocks: Nothing yet. Conversation practice already lives under Speaking.

roadmap.title: Roadmap
roadmap.body: The path Korume is drawing from what you actually study, not from a fixed syllabus.
roadmap.unlocks: Keep studying. A roadmap needs a few weeks of real sessions before it says anything true.

weeklyReport.title: Weekly Report
weeklyReport.body: One honest summary a week: what moved, what did not, and what Korume adjusted.
weeklyReport.unlocks: Finish a week of sessions and the first report writes itself.

statistics.title: Statistics
statistics.body: The numbers behind your sessions — time, accuracy and coverage over time.
statistics.unlocks: Nothing yet. This screen arrives once session history is being aggregated.

achievements.title: Achievements
achievements.body: Badges you have earned, and the ones within reach.
achievements.unlocks: Badges are awarded already; this screen is where they will be shown.

settings.title: Settings
settings.body: Account, language, motion, and control over your own data.
settings.unlocks: Nothing yet. Data export and deletion land with this screen.

explore.title: Explore Lessons
explore.body: Every lesson in Korume, arranged for discovery rather than for your own library.
explore.unlocks: Nothing yet. This screen is being built.

pronunciation.title: Pronunciation
pronunciation.body: Pitch accent, rhythm, and the sounds that keep slipping — practised on their own rather than only inside a lesson.
pronunciation.unlocks: Scoring already runs inside Shadowing. This screen is where it becomes practice you can choose.

companion.title: Companion
companion.body: One place for the companion studying alongside you — its diary, what it remembers of your sessions, and where it thinks you are growing.
companion.unlocks: The Diary already exists and moves here. The rest arrives with the Companion hub.
